newsitem.title: SPAIN: Bank of Spain buying pesetas versus marks - dealers.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Spain buying pesetas versus marks - dealers.

text.p: The Bank of Spain was buying pesetas versus the mark around 84.85, dealers said on Wednesday.
"There is lot of demand for marks, and we are seeing the Bank of Spain buying pesetas once again," one dealer said.
The Bank of Spain was not immediately available, although it usually does not comment on reports of intervention.
At 0840 GMT, the peseta was trading at 84.84/87 to the mark versus Tuesday's closing level at 84.74/75.
On Tuesday, dealers reported massive intervention around 84.75 per mark. -- Madrid newsroom +341 585 2160
